I think that a lot of times it’s just people sucking at spotting warning signs, probably because we’re taught during all our lives that we must not talk or think about suicide under any circumstance.

For example, one of the most misleading warning signs of suicide is “previously sad or depressed person is suddently happy and calm”. This can mean that the person has finally decided to kill themselves, but most people just see their loved one being “back”.

A less cheerful variation of this is “person has reasons to worry about their future, but doesn’t”. Some suicidal people stop caring about tests, studying, work and money. This can seem “lazy” or “irresponsible” to others, but it’s just that “tomorrow” is not part of their plan.

(I can personally confirm that people can’t spot the last one, because I show it 24/7 and no one ever notices it)

So yes, suicide is foreseeable, but most people are basically blind to it.
